description: End-to-end smoke suite. Verifies the harness loop: prompt → daemon chat → worktree checker → scorecard. No benchmark content, safe to commit and publish.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named answer.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 42 on a single line. When writing, use file_write with the direct:true argument so the file is written to disk immediately.
List the files in the current directory and write the list, one file per line, to a new file named inventory.txt.
Create a file named summary.txt in the repository root containing the text: meept is an AI agent daemon. Use file_write with direct:true.
